docs.title: IFSCL Mods
docs.text:
Modding notes for IFSCL (BepInEx 5, Harmony). Two parts:

  • Internals: how the game is built, in prose. No decompiled code here.
  • API: what the plugin exposes to modders (coming).

docs.title: Game startup
docs.text:
Entry point: GamePreInit (IFSCL.Runtime). Two loading waves:

  1. AfterAssembliesLoaded: static reference tables (XxxList.PRE_LOAD()).
  2. AfterSceneLoad → LoadAll(): content files loaded async, a second wave of PRE_LOAD, then fullyLoaded = true.

BepInEx hooks AfterSceneLoad (see the README, entrypoint section).

docs.title: Translations
docs.text:
Assembly Translations. Three layers:

  • Row: one id plus six languages (en, fr, it, es, pl, pt). Stores, decides nothing.
  • DB: one table per class (Words, OptionNames, OptionDescr...), indexed by id, filled in the constructor through AddRow.
  • MSG (IFSCL.Runtime): applies the rules. Current language is VarG.langage. A translation equal to "" or "-" falls back to English. Unknown id → NOTFOUND : id displayed as is, never an exception.

Immudelki's rule: English is mandatory, the rest is optional.
